title: Detector infrastructure: §8.1 contract, read-only context, total criterion→detector registry
rationale: trellis-5963 builds src/detectors/ as 3 core modules + barrel. types.ts is the SPEC §8.1 contract verbatim (DetectionContext, DetectorResult{numerator 0|1|null, denominator literal 1, naKind?, rationale}, Detector) plus a zod detectorResultSchema and pass/fail/notApplicable/noDetector constructors that clamp rationale to MAX_RATIONALE and enforce the numerator↔naKind biconditional. NaKind/MAX_RATIONALE are re-exported from scoring so detector + scorecard share one §3.2/§6.2 vocabulary (detectors depends on scoring; no cycle). context.ts createDetectionContext roots readFile/glob/run at repoPath/app.path, refuses to escape repo (contain() via path.relative), and run() NEVER throws — missing tool→exit 127, timeout→timedOut+kill — so detectors map failures to noDetector() not crashes. No write surface by construction = read-only mandate. registry.ts DetectorRegistry.resolve is TOTAL: per-language adapter (first app-language match wins) > common > no-detector stub; unbound or no-adapter never crashes, never false-passes. BINDINGS is empty until detector issues (d600/299e/3d67/89b4/7f70) populate it; the no-detector fallback already satisfies 'covers all 70 deterministic ids'. Tests cross-check registry keys ⊆ deterministic rubric ids and that all 70 resolve to schema-valid results.

title: Common language-agnostic detectors (§5.4/5.5/5.7/5.8): presence-checks + one VCS-CLI probe, §3.2-clean naKind
rationale: trellis-d600 implements src/detectors/common/ as 5 detector modules (environment/ci-release/security/process/quality) + util.ts helpers + a barrel that re-exports detector FUNCTIONS only; registry.ts imports them and wraps with commonBinding so the dep stays one-directional (registry → common → types, no cycle). BINDINGS now binds 31 deterministic criterion ids (was empty). KEY DESIGN: (1) §3.2 naKind rule applied uniformly — NON-SKIPPABLE → present=pass/absent=fail, never N/A (env_template, gitignore_comprehensive, deps_pinned, devcontainer, vcs_cli_tools, dependency_update_automation, release_notes_automation, release_automation, feature_flag_infrastructure, min_release_age, codeowners, issue_templates, issue_labeling_system, pr_templates, large_file_detection, tech_debt_tracking, pre_commit_hooks); SKIPPABLE presence-checkable infra → present=pass/absent=not-applicable (monorepo_tooling, version_drift_detection, dead_feature_flag_detection, build_performance_tracking, progressive_rollout, rollback_automation, branch_protection, automated_security_review, secret_scanning, privacy_compliance, automated_pr_review, backlog_health); SKIPPABLE signals needing RUN HISTORY → static bound=pass / surface-present-but-unmeasurable=no-detector / no-surface=not-applicable (fast_ci_feedback via timeout-minutes<=10, deployment_frequency). (2) branch_protection is the only §8.1 'via VCS CLI' probe: git remote get-url → parseRemote(host/slug) → gh api repos/{slug}/rulesets --jq length (github) / glab api protected_branches (gitlab); no remote=N/A, CLI missing(127)/unknown host=no-detector, clean answer=pass/fail. Refactored into probeGithub/probeGitlab helpers to clear biome cognitive-complexity<=15. (3) detectors only touch ctx.readFile/glob/run (no direct fs) so they inherit containment + never-throws; SPAWN_FAILURE_EXIT(127) imported from context.ts. (4) util.ts: globHits(dedupe+sort), firstHit, readJson(rejects arrays+non-objects), readWorkflows(.github/workflows + .gitlab-ci.yml), packageScripts/packageDeps. TESTS: fixture-driven per detector via real temp dirs + createDetectionContext (no fs mocks per convention); CLI-probe detectors stub ONLY ctx.run via {...ctx, run}. Updated registry.test.ts acceptance ctx from a bare cast to a functional empty-repo stub (readFile→null/glob→[]/run→127) so real detectors execute and return schema-valid results. 132 detector tests, 326 total, check:all exits 0; calibrated against trellis's own files (l5 toolkit ratchets, dependabot cooldown, core.hooksPath prepare) so dogfood passes.

title: TypeScript adapter detectors: config-first, with exact import-graph cycle detection
rationale: trellis-299e implements src/detectors/lang/typescript/ as 6 modules (util/graph/code-quality/testing/observability/locality) binding 22 TS-applicable deterministic criteria via languageBinding. Discipline per SPEC §3.2/§8.3: stack-concept criteria with a real TS analogue (explicit_any, greppable_exports, barrel, strict*) grade pass/fail and NEVER not-applicable (that bucket is for the Swift/Python adapters); optional-tooling skippables (code_modularization, machine_checked_architecture, mutation_testing) map honest absence to not-applicable; non-skippables fail on absent config. Most detectors are config/dep/script-presence checks over JSONC-tolerant tsconfig (bounded extends-merge) + Biome rule levels. Three exceptions: type_check and unit_tests_runnable actually run the repo's command (no-detector on exit 127/timeout; unit_tests_runnable parses ≥1 executed test, fails no-ops); import_cycle_detection is computed EXACTLY from a relative-import graph (graph.ts, no external tool — a cycle is unambiguous so zero false positives). Tests stub ctx.run for the exec paths and use temp/in-mem fixtures for the rest. Keep functions under biome cognitive-complexity 15 by extracting helpers.

title: Swift adapter detectors: config-first, honest cross-language not-applicable
rationale: trellis-3d67 implements src/detectors/lang/swift/ as 4 modules (util/code-quality/testing/locality) mirroring the TS adapter. Config-first: SwiftLint(.swiftlint.yml + default-rule allowlist/disabled_rules semantics), swift-format/SwiftFormat, periphery, jscpd, muter detected via config files OR a gatherToolingText() sweep (Package.swift+Makefile+Mint/Brewfile+CI workflows+scripts/). swift build/swift test run as subprocesses → exit 127 maps to no-detector so CI without a Swift toolchain never false-fails (tests stub run, never require swift). The 6 concepts Swift lacks (unused_dependencies_detection, greppable_exports, barrel_file_reexport_detection, explicit_any_detection, import_cycle_detection, mutation_testing-when-unconfigured) resolve not-applicable with a rationale naming the gap — sanctioned by SPEC §8.3 'a criterion with no analogue resolves to not-applicable' even for skippable:false criteria (overrides the §3.2 non-skippable rule for the cross-language case). Registry adds swift to each languageBinding.

title: Python adapter detectors: config-first, deptry gradable, mypy --strict is the strictness ceiling
rationale: trellis-89b4 implements src/detectors/lang/python/ as 4 modules (util/code-quality/testing/locality) mirroring the Swift adapter. Detection is config-first via a single locateTool probe (dedicated dotfile → [tool.X]/INI section in pyproject/setup.cfg/tox.ini → build-tooling mention), no TOML/INI parser. Only type_check (mypy .) and unit_tests_runnable (pytest) run a tool, degrading to no-detector on exit 127/timeout. Unlike Swift, unused_dependencies_detection is GRADABLE (deptry), not N/A. import_cycle_detection (import-linter/grimp/pydeps) and orphan_module_detection (pydeps/tach) are gradable for Python. explicit_any_detection/greppable_exports/barrel_file_reexport_detection/strictest_type_checking resolve to not-applicable per SPEC 8.3 (mypy --strict, graded by strict_typing, is the ceiling). Registry now binds python on all three languages; build.test.ts language-hint test updated since python is no longer adapter-less.

title: os-eco-native detectors (§8.4) are an evidence OVERLAY folded in build.ts, not registry bindings
rationale: SPEC §8.4 maps os-eco surfaces onto existing criteria — several of which (agents_md, skills, automated_doc_generation, documentation_freshness, agentic_development) are AGENT-discovery criteria the registry test forbids binding. So trellis-7f70 keeps the registry pure and instead exposes OSECO_OVERLAY (src/detectors/oseco/evidence.ts) + applyOsecoOverlay (overlay.ts), which build.ts.scoreAllCriteria folds over each non-skipped base verdict: pass-if-either, repo-rooted evidence run once on repoCtx, app-scope pass projects N/N. Gated by ctx.osecoDetectors (default on); a missing surface or toggle=false is an exact no-op; targets.yaml skip wins. Detectors return pass when present / notApplicable when absent so the merge only ever lifts. Watch the file-size ratchet: build.ts sits exactly at the 400-line cap, so net additions there must be paid back by trimming comments.

description: import_cycle_detection reported false cycles on trellis itself: the TS graph builder's specifier regexes matched import()-shaped text inside COMMENTS — a JSDoc {@link import("../registry.ts")} doc-link and commented-out imports forged phantom edges (registry.ts<->common/index.ts). The detector promises 'no false positives' but had one.
resolution: Added stripComments() char-scanner in graph.ts that blanks line/block comments before specifier extraction while preserving string literals (so real specifiers still match) and skipping // inside strings. Also broke a real type-only cycle report/types.ts<->report/changes.ts by moving the §11 delta types into types.ts. trellis findCycle now returns null.
